userStories.title: Create sparselink repo with unified interface
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a standalone sparselink repo with a unified fit(X) -> AdjacencyMatrix interface, common types (AdjacencyMatrix, EdgeList, InferenceResult), and method registry pattern so that all algorithms share a consistent API.
acceptanceCriteria: Separate git repo created for sparselink
Unified interface: each method implements fit(X) -> AdjacencyMatrix or fit(X, y) -> EdgeWeights
Common types defined: AdjacencyMatrix, EdgeList, InferenceResult
Method registry pattern implemented for discovery/enumeration
All methods accept numpy arrays / pandas DataFrames

acceptanceCriteria: LASSO implementation ported and conforms to unified interface

Unit tests pass for each method
